public.title: Kth Largest Element in an Array
public.description: Return the kth value in descending sorted order, counting duplicates. k is 1-based and between 1 and values.length. There are 1 to 1000 integers, each from -10000 to 10000.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026. Uses a standard algorithmic pattern; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: Sorting in descending order places the required value at index k-1. Time O(n log n), space O(n).
